# Everyone Film Editorial 1.4.0 — visual comparison with the Floward reference

Reference: `Floward Launch | Cast Shortlist - V3` (35 pages, 1920×1080 pt, Keynote). It shows real people, so its
renders, crops, side-by-side and difference images stay in `.local/cycle7/visual/` (git-ignored) and are not
committed. Only measurements are recorded here.

## Method (reproducible)

1. Reference rasterised at 72 dpi → 1920×1080 px (`pdftoppm -r 72`), `.local/cycle7/visual/ref/`.
2. Render: `npx tsx development/cycle7/visual/render-1-4.mts` builds the Floward structure with synthetic
   people (`tests/fixtures/reference-review.ts` `floward()`: same titles, subtitles, notes, dividers, page
   numbers and page count as the reference) and renders it through the worker's actual path
   (`renderPresentationPdf` + `validatePresentationPdf`, Chromium 156.0.8078.4, pinned General Sans TrueType).
   The PDF is 1440×810 pt and rasterised at 96 dpi → 1920×1080 px.
3. `python -X utf8 development/cycle7/visual/compare.py` measures non-background bands (|Δ| > 10 from
   #F1F1F1) and the yellow highlight box per page and writes side-by-side, 50 % overlay and difference images.

Pages compared: 1, 2, 3, 8, 9, 10, 17, 18, 33, 35. The reference splits its five "2 Featured Male Guests" options
2+3 (with one deliberately empty picture); 1.4.0 splits five options 3+2 as specified, so reference 9 (pair) is
compared with render 10 and reference 10 (triple) with render 9.

Page 33 (heading, subtitle, open-role silhouette, "Note: Missing.", page number) contains no person and was
compared pixel for pixel: 668 of 2,073,600 pixels differ by more than 32 levels (0.03 %), all glyph
anti-aliasing. Text-only pages differ only at glyph edges (page 2: 2,881 px, page 17: 2,939 px, page 35:
2,105 px > 32 levels) — Keynote vs Chromium rasterisation of the same General Sans outlines.

## Remaining deltas

- Reference page 10 places its note 8 px higher (y1023) than page 33 (y1031); the reference is itself
  inconsistent. 1.4.0 uses the page-33 position for every note.
- Sub-pixel anti-aliasing at portrait edges and glyph edges (≤1 px).
- Reference cover uses "l" (lower-case L) as the title separator; 1.4.0 draws the template's raised "|".
- PowerPoint: produced through the real `versionPptx` path (`.local/cycle7/visual/out/deck.pptx`, 35 slides,
  native text and pictures). LibreOffice (`soffice`) is not installed on this machine, so the PPTX was not
  rasterised; it was inspected structurally (slide count, texts, picture count, no hyperlinks).
